Fixed 3 critical TDZ (temporal dead zone) bugs in PropertyDetail.js, AgentDashboard.js, AdminDashboard.js where useCallback functions were declared AFTER useEffect that used them.

ui_bugs.issue: Sign In button click via Playwright does not trigger auth (auth key mismatch: API returns 'session_token', frontend reads 'pb_session_token'). Works in real browser. Login flow tested via localStorage injection in Playwright.

fixed_bugs.bug: ReferenceError: Cannot access 'fetchAll' before initialization - same TDZ pattern. Fixed by moving fetchAll useCallback before useEffect.

To test AgentDashboard ImageUpload form, need an agent-role user (not admin). Admin role is redirected to /admin from /agent. Use localStorage.setItem('pb_session_token', token) to bypass login modal in Playwright tests.
rca_of_issue: All 3 bugs had same root cause: JavaScript temporal dead zone (TDZ). In React components, useCallback creates a variable binding that is hoisted but not initialized until execution reaches that line. When useEffect references the useCallback function before the declaration line, ReferenceError is thrown. Fix: always declare useCallback/useMemo before useEffect that depends on them.
